dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures feature thin, high-intensity perimeters that define a transition from darker exterior background pixels to the lighter ring geometry, surrounding darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity specular clusters are concentrated along the dorsal ridge and the cranial-flipper region; low-intensity solid pixel clusters are sparsely distributed along the lower longitudinal axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle across the mid-section of the subject.

other_distinctive_markers: A jagged, near-continuous line of high-intensity pixels extends horizontally across the lower lateral region, separating the dorsal pattern from the ventral-facing surface.
